summary: Discussion-roundup: multiple high-impact safety incidents (OpenAI training pause, agent DNS tunnelling, repo-based code-exec), product shifts (Microsoft Copilot changes), operator signals on observability and prompt-injection, plus rising infra projects (agent memory, DeepSeek). | Vendor releases highlight agent-focused product launches (Anthropic, Cloudflare, Mistral, JetBrains), MCP/memory/sandbox upgrades, and several research papers on agent evaluation/security. Missing social/operator reports for workflow impact. | GitHub-only snapshot: mix of vendor releases (OpenAI, Anthropic, Vercel, GitHub changelog) and operator/infra repos (nanobot, OpenSandbox, agent-HA bridge, CloudCruise CLI). Prioritize official releases and high-star infra; flag repo-only items for social/second-source corroboration. | Package-layer snapshot: official vendor libs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Vercel, AWS) and multiple MCP/sandbox/eval primitives plus security/observability packages; packages-only shard lacks social user reports for operator workflows.
